Intel: extract structure from Python function definition

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"python\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "def greet(name):\n    return f'Hello, {name}!'\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
debugPrint(result.structure())
debugPrint(result.structure()[0].kind())
debugPrint(result.metrics().totalLines())
debugPrint(result.metrics().errorCount())
```
